note: Alberta Parks campground in aspen and spruce near the south end of Goldeye Lake, 8 km west of Nordegg on Hwy 11 then 3 km north on the access road, run by Westward Bound Campgrounds. Boat launch, hand launch, pier and fish-cleaning station on the stocked lake, with a loop trail around it; firewood is sold. --Claude
summary: Confirmed against the Alberta Parks page and shop site list: 42 unserviced sites (24 reservable, 18 first-come), $28, vault toilets, pump water not safe to drink. Season corrected from an approximate May-Sept to the posted May 8 - Oct 3 (2026); max length 95 ft added; count 40 -> 42.
